entries.title: Check and top up engine oil
entries.meaning: Let's check the engine oil level, and top it up if it's low.
aliases: how do I check the oil
escalate_if: oil light stays on while driving
safety: Park on level ground and switch the engine off.
Wait at least ten minutes so the engine cools and the oil settles.

steps.say: Open the bonnet and look at the engine.
steps.target: the engine under the open bonnet

steps.say: Find the dipstick. It has a yellow ring handle.
steps.target: yellow ring handle of the engine oil dipstick

steps.say: Pull the dipstick out and wipe it clean with a cloth.
steps.target: yellow ring handle of the engine oil dipstick

steps.say: Push it all the way back in, then pull it out again.
steps.target: yellow ring handle of the engine oil dipstick

steps.say: The oil line should be between the two marks near the tip.
If it's below the low mark, unscrew the oil filler cap with the oil can symbol.
steps.target: engine oil filler cap with the oil can symbol
steps.verify: the engine oil filler cap is removed and the round filler opening is visible

steps.say: Pour in a little oil at a time, then wait a minute and check the dipstick again.
steps.target: round engine oil filler opening
steps.caution: Use the oil grade from your owner's manual, and don't overfill.

steps.say: Screw the filler cap back on tightly and put the dipstick all the way in.
steps.target: engine oil filler cap

entries.title: Check the engine coolant
entries.meaning: Let's check the coolant level in the see-through tank.
safety: Only check the coolant when the engine is completely cold.
Never open the coolant cap on a hot engine. Hot coolant can burn you.

steps.say: Find the see-through coolant tank with MIN and MAX marks.
steps.target: translucent coolant reservoir with MIN and MAX marks

steps.say: Look at the side of the tank. The coolant should be between MIN and MAX.
steps.target: translucent coolant reservoir with MIN and MAX marks

steps.say: If it's below MIN and the engine is cold, slowly open the tank cap.
steps.target: cap of the coolant reservoir
steps.verify: the coolant reservoir cap is off

steps.say: Top up with the coolant from your manual until it reaches MAX.
steps.target: open coolant reservoir

steps.say: Close the cap tightly.
steps.target: cap of the coolant reservoir

entries.title: Top up windscreen washer fluid
entries.meaning: Let's fill up the windscreen washer fluid.
escalate_if: pump makes noise but nothing sprays
safety: Switch the engine off before you reach into the engine bay.

steps.say: Find the washer fluid cap. It has a windscreen and water spray symbol.
steps.target: cap of the windshield washer fluid reservoir with the wiper symbol

steps.say: Flip or twist the cap open.
steps.target: cap of the windshield washer fluid reservoir with the wiper symbol
steps.verify: the windshield washer fluid cap is open

steps.say: Pour in washer fluid or clean water until it's nearly full.
steps.target: open windshield washer fluid filler neck

steps.say: Close the cap until it clicks.
steps.target: cap of the windshield washer fluid reservoir

entries.title: Open a laptop's bottom cover for cleaning
entries.meaning: Let's take the bottom cover off so you can clean the dust out.
aliases: open the back of the laptop
safety: Shut the laptop down and unplug the charger.
Work on a soft cloth, and touch something metal first to discharge static.

steps.say: Close the lid and turn the laptop over.
steps.target: the bottom cover of the laptop

steps.say: Remove every small screw around the bottom cover and keep them in a cup.
steps.target: the edge area of the bottom cover where its screws are
steps.caution: Some screws may be hidden under the rubber feet or labels.

steps.say: Gently pry the cover up from a corner with a plastic card, never a metal tool.
steps.target: a corner of the bottom cover
steps.verify: the laptop bottom cover is lifted off

steps.say: Blow the dust out of the fan with short puffs of air, holding the fan still.
steps.target: the cooling fan
steps.caution: Don't touch the battery or the circuit board.

steps.say: Put the cover back and screw every screw back in its hole.
steps.target: the bottom cover of the laptop
